story-spark 1.0.1

- Added new reference and script files to enhance documentation and functionality.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file for a cleaner repository.

Initial release of Story Spark.  
- Generates creative fiction prompts from your personal photos, journal entries, and notes.
- Analyzes emotionally resonant moments using photo metadata and text analysis.
- Transforms real experiences into detailed story seeds across multiple genres (literary, mystery, sci-fi, horror, romance, historical).
- Provides a simple command-line interface with options for source selection, genre, and output format.
- Prompts include source detail, genre, premise, character suggestion, conflict, and twist.
- Demo mode available; works without user files for easy testing.
